name: YouTube Monetization-Safe Beats Pack
description: 6 original copyright-safe Flow Music instrumentals mirroring SOUNDTRACK_CURATION_GUIDE.md and CHANNEL_BLUEPRINT.md.

tracks.title: Midnight Rhodes Pocket (Neo-Soul Swing)
tracks.cueNotes: Designed for -20 dB sidechain ducking under gaming commentary and breakdowns.
tracks.prompt: Laid-back 1990s neo-soul instrumental at 84 BPM in D minor. Unquantized J Dilla swing drums, warm Fender Rhodes seventh chords, deep soulful analog bassline, crisp rimshot pocket, subtle vinyl dust. Instrumental only, zero vocals, wide space in midrange for voiceovers.
tracks.lyrics:
[Instrumental]
Neo-soul groove for commentary & gameplay breakdowns.

tracks.title: Highway Overdrive (80s JP Jazz Fusion)
tracks.cueNotes: High-octane montage and ranked highlight groove.
tracks.prompt: Upbeat 1980s Japanese jazz fusion instrumental at 124 BPM in E major. Shimmering Yamaha DX7 FM synth pads, technical melodic slap bass, tight crisp snare fills, euphoric Stratocaster electric guitar lead melody, sparkling synth brass stabs. Instrumental only.

tracks.title: Neon Coastline (City Pop Funk Chop)
tracks.cueNotes: Crisp transitions, shorts hooks, and cozy showcases.
tracks.prompt: Sparkling 1982 Tokyo City Pop funk instrumental at 112 BPM in A major. Clean Stratocaster sixteenth-note funk chop guitar, glossy analog synth brass, bouncy Moog-style bassline, crisp snare clap, uplifting summery night-drive chord progression. Instrumental only.
tracks.lyrics:
[Instrumental]
City pop groove for Shorts and transitions.

tracks.title: Dark Tournament Boogie (90s Anime Funk)
tracks.cueNotes: PvP comebacks, Tekken/Marshall Law clutches, and tournament highlights.
tracks.prompt: Rebellious 1990s anime tournament action groove at 134 BPM in G minor. Gritty slap bass, punchy alto sax and brass horn stabs, crunchy funk guitar riffs, hard-hitting live-room drum breaks. High swagger martial arts showdown energy, instrumental only.

tracks.title: Rainy Shibuya Lounge (Acid Jazz Beat)
tracks.prompt: Smooth late-night Japanese acid jazz and lo-fi instrumental at 88 BPM in F minor. Muted upright acoustic bass, warm rainy electric piano chords, dusty brushed boom-bap drum loop, subtle jazz flute accents. Warm low end, calm midrange headroom for spoken voiceover, instrumental only.

tracks.title: Starlight Fountain Garden (Nocturnal Sleep Bed)
tracks.cueNotes: Use Google Flow Music Extend tool to generate 4-8 minute seamless variations for 1-8h Cartoon/Gaming White Noise uploads without triggering repetitious content flags.
tracks.prompt: Gentle dreamy late-90s cozy simulation garden ambient music at 68 BPM in C major. Soft marimba sparkles, warm muted Rhodes pads, gentle acoustic harp arpeggios, airy water-like synth textures, zero harsh drums or sudden transients. Hypnotic, nostalgic, and soothing for sleep and study, instrumental only.
tracks.lyrics:
[Instrumental]
Nocturnal ambient garden bed for sleep & study loops.
